rules.label: Stretched from 50-day SMA
rules.origin: Distance from the intermediate mean in ATR units (Raschke & Connors)
rules.rule: Close more than 3 ATR above the 50-day SMA; full points at 7 ATR

rules.label: RSI-2 extreme
rules.origin: Larry Connors & Cesar Alvarez, Short Term Trading Strategies That Work (2009)

rules.label: Through the floor pivots
rules.origin: Classic floor-trader pivots from yesterday's high, low and close
rules.rule: Above R1 = 1/3, above R2 = 2/3, above R3 = full points

rules.label: Volume climax
rules.origin: Richard Wyckoff's buying climax; relative volume at the same time of day
rules.rule: Volume so far today at least 2x the 20-session average by this time; full points at 5x

rules.label: Run from the open
rules.origin: Wilder's ATR as the yardstick; Toby Crabel, Day Trading with Short Term Price Patterns and Opening Range Breakout (1990)
rules.rule: Price more than 1 daily ATR above today's open; full points at 2.5 ATR

rules.label: Giving back from the high
rules.origin: Failed push / upthrust (Wyckoff): the run is already being sold
rules.rule: After a run of 1+ ATR, a quarter or more of it handed back from the high; full points at 60%
rules.value: 45% of the run given back from 79.00
